name: Planning Pod
description_en:
Planning Pod currently describes itself as venue-first management software for organizations that sell, book and host events in spaces they operate. It connects lead intake, booking calendars, floor plans, banquet event orders, food and beverage, proposals, contracts, invoices and client communication. Event planners without a venue may also use it, but the stated roadmap and support priority is venues.

That identity is different from a public ticket marketplace or a simple RSVP page. A venue should evaluate the handoff from enquiry to contract, operational instructions and deposit reconciliation, as well as the cost and data consequences of changing or ending its subscription.
description_zh:
Planning Pod 目前明确以场地管理优先，面向销售、预订并在自有运营空间举办活动的组织，连接线索、日历、平面图、宴会执行单、餐饮、提案、合同、发票和客户沟通。无场地策划人也可使用，但路线图及支持重点是场地。

这一身份不同于公开售票市场或简单 RSVP 页面。场地方应核对询盘到合同、执行说明和订金对账，也要考虑变更或结束订阅的费用与数据后果。

core_features.explanation_en: Connect calendar, layout, BEO and resources to the client event.
core_features.explanation_zh: 把日历、布局、宴会执行单及资源关联到客户活动。

core_features.explanation_en: Manage proposals, signatures, invoices, installments and branded portals.
core_features.explanation_zh: 管理提案、签名、发票、分期及品牌客户门户。

en: Manage a venue reception from enquiry to signed contract, BEO and deposit reconciliation.
zh: 管理场地招待会从询盘到合同、执行单及订金核对。
use_cases.basis: Editorial task suggestions based on official documentation; no observed deployment.

steps.en: Map the venue workflow and existing records, clarify migration/support scope and validate one complete booking plus an export.
steps.zh: 映射场地流程与已有记录，明确迁移/支持范围，核对一条完整预订及导出。

items.en: Selection judgments and examples are documentation-based; no live workflow was tested.
items.zh: 选型判断与例子依据文档，未实测真实流程。

pricing.billing_basis: USD recurring subscription, capacity/entitlement from selected proposal; optional services and payment costs.
pricing.source_snapshot_en: Current subscription amount not verified. Terms specify USD monthly/yearly advance billing, with potential paid migration/training and support overages. Written cancellation and confirmation are required; no prorated subscription refund and data may be purged after cancellation. Obtain a scoped current proposal.
pricing.source_snapshot_zh: 未核实现行订阅金额。条款为美元月付/年付预收，迁移/培训和超额支持可能另费。取消需书面申请及确认，不按比例退订阅费，取消后可能清数据，应取得现行范围提案。

sources.title: Planning Pod — Venue management software venues actually run on
sources.research_notes_en: Current venue-first positioning with booking calendar, floorplans, BEOs, proposals, contracts, payments and client portals; marketing outcome numbers not adopted.

sources.title: Planning Pod - Terms and Conditions
sources.research_notes_en: Actual terms define USD recurring subscriptions, optional paid migration, support limits, written cancellation and data purge; no current amount established.

sources.title: Planning Pod | Contact us
sources.research_notes_en: Pre-sales and demo contact routes, support hours; no advertised fixed quote amount.

official_check.scope: Public official documents read; no purchase, account setup, independent review, hands-on test, identity verification or publication approval.

review_notes: Official documentation describes vendor functionality, not independent evidence of reliability, adoption or outcomes.
Original English synthesis and corresponding Chinese draft; examples and fit judgments are editorial guidance.
Current public pricing is a dated snapshot; purchase conditions remain subject to vendor confirmation.

sections.title_en: Follow the booking into a usable operations document
sections.title_zh: 把预订落实成可执行文件
sections.en: For an illustrative venue reception, capture the enquiry, hold the date, issue a proposal and signed contract, then align layout, catering and BEO details with the payment schedule. A changed guest count should be checked against the invoice and operational instructions, not merely the calendar. Integrated tools do not prove every template or automation fits the venue’s rules. No booking, signature, BEO or payment was executed.
sections.zh: 例如场地招待会，应收集询盘、暂留日期、出具提案和签约，再让布局、餐饮和宴会执行单与付款计划一致。人数变化需同时核对发票和执行说明，不只看日历。集成工具不证明每个模板和自动化都符合场地规则，本文未执行预订、签名、执行单或支付。

sections.title_en: Compare onboarding promises with the written service scope
sections.title_zh: 对照上线宣传与书面服务范围
sections.en: The homepage promotes human-assisted migration and support. The terms separately describe migration as an optional paid service, limit what can migrate and require discrepancy reporting within ten business days. They also state support allowances that may incur extra charges. Obtain the applicable proposal before assuming unlimited free migration or support. Validate contacts, calendars, contracts and templates against the original export before accepting a move.
sections.zh: 首页宣传人工迁移和支持，条款则把迁移列为可选付费服务，限制可迁范围并要求十个工作日内报告差异，还列有可能额外收费的支持额度。不能假定迁移和支持无限免费，应先核具体提案，验收前把联系人、日历、合同和模板与原始导出核对。

sections.title_en: Confirm USD subscription and cancellation mechanics
sections.title_zh: 确认美元订阅与取消机制
sections.en: The read terms require USD payment and describe monthly or annual subscriptions billed in advance. No current subscription amount or definitive capacity-price matrix was verified. The cancellation section requires a written request through the account or contact form and a confirmation email; non-use or payment default is not cancellation. Access ends at the paid term, with no prorated refund, and account data may be purged after cancellation. Export necessary records before ending service.
sections.zh: 已读条款要求美元付款，月度或年度订阅预先计费，未确定现行金额或完整容量价格表。取消需通过账户或联系表单书面提出并收到确认邮件，不使用或拒付不等于取消。访问到已付期限结束，不按比例退款，取消后可清除数据。结束服务前应先导出必要记录。

sections.en: Payment processing and settlement, refunds and chargebacks involve the selected provider, despite the homepage’s integrated-payment language. Confirm current integration and transaction charges. Planning Pod merits investigation for venue sales and operations; a ticket-only conference may need a different scope. No source license or self-hosted package was verified. Terms say customers should maintain their own backups, so a hosted record is not a substitute for an export/recovery plan. Vendor savings and booking-growth claims were not independently measured.
sections.zh: 支付结算、退款与拒付涉及所选提供商，即使首页称支付一体化，也需确认当前连接和交易费。场地销售及运营可研究 Planning Pod，纯售票会议可能需要不同范围。本次未确认源码许可或自托管，条款要求客户自行备份，因此托管记录不能替代导出/恢复计划。节省及预订增长主张未独立测量。

research_gaps: No booking, migration, contract, payment, BEO, integration, export or cancellation was tested.
Current amount/capacity, homepage-versus-terms migration/support scope, processor fees, contract data terms, source license and self-hosting require confirmation.
